title: SWAP5 WOFOST81 Migration Preservation

current_swap5_surface.current_rate_parameterization: compact pre-WOFOST81/B1.10-style bundle with AMAXTB/KDIF/EFF and no explicit AMAX_REF, AMAX_SLP, AMAX_LNB or KN fields
current_swap5_surface.weather_forcing_readiness: current one-day forcing already carries daylength, SINLD, COSLD, DIFPP and DSINBE-equivalent preprocessed astronomy/weather values, so raw-weather preprocessing need not be imported into the crop owner

assimilation.key_semantics: leaf-N profile directly constrains AMAX; this is not equivalent to the current AMAXTB-only SWAP5 path

required_contracts: N stress for leaf death and RGRLAI

migration_constraints: do not replace existing WOFOST semantics globally; WOFOST81 must be an explicit versioned/qualified path
preserve transaction/rollback ownership and clone/validate semantics
do not import SWAP4.3.1 RD or TRA interface behavior into the PP02 crop-state contract
do not couple Soil-N implementation into the crop algorithm; expose a request/supply seam so non-limiting PP qualification and future production Soil-N coupling remain separable
reuse the admitted PP01 oracle precision unchanged
no production change may be called qualified until the ten-case preservation gate passes
minimum_implementation_sequence: add versioned WOFOST81 parameter and leaf-N assimilation substrate without changing legacy path
add transaction-owned WOFOST81 N state and pure request/apply/N-stress kernels
compose WOFOST81 daily evolution through the existing accepted crop-window transaction seam
add observation mapping for the admitted 12-output reference surface
run all ten PP01 trajectories with the same non-limiting external water/N boundary and exact YAML precision
next_permitted_action: QUALIFY the first minimal migration slice: source-faithful WOFOST81 assimilation and N-state kernels behind new versioned contracts, with donor-component oracle tests before composing them into the daily crop owner.
exclusions: no replacement of existing legacy WOFOST path
